lines.t: This game just broke its own player record, and it still hasn't officially launched.
Deadlock is Valve's six versus six hero shooter. It mixes third person shooting with a Dota style map.
It's set in a haunted version of 1940s New York, called the Cursed Apple.

sc.label: REAL 1940s NEW YORK: THE INSPIRATION
sc.credit: Photo: William P. Gottlieb, 1948, public domain

lines.t: It leaked in May 2024, under the name Neon Prime.
Valve said nothing for months. One reporter was even banned from the game for previewing it early.

sc.sub: a reporter previewed it too early

lines.t: That September it peaked at 171,000 players, while it was still invite only.
Then came this week's update, The City Never Sleeps. Six new heroes, four new districts, and over ten thousand new voice lines.
On September 30th, it set a new record: 228,086 players at once.
The new heroes arrive two per week, with names like Rat King and Deadman Danny.
The roster has grown from about 20 heroes to around 40.
Fun fact: fans drew a new look for the hero Ivy, and Valve redesigned her to match.

sc.sub: Ivy was redesigned to match it

lines.t: It's free, it's PC only, and it still has no release date.
Who's your main? Comment for which game we should review next! Follow for more!
